topic: 非谓语动词 (Non-finite Verbs: To do, Doing, Done)
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：非谓语动词就是动词的“变装秀”！在一个完整的英语句子中，主角（谓语动词）只有一个。如果别的动词也想加入句子，就必须卸下“主唱”身份，穿上变装服（变成 to do、doing 或 done），去充当定语、状语、宾语等角色，绝对不能再抢主角的位置。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
- to do（不定式）：表示“将来、目的、未发生”（去干某事）。
- doing（动名词/现在分词）：表示“正在进行、习惯体验、主动动作”。
- done（过去分词）：表示“被动完成、某种状态”。
- 记口诀：一句不纳二主动，非谓变装显神通；将来目的用 to do，正在习惯用 doing，被动完成 done 搞定！
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
- 错点1：双谓语冲突。如误写 *I like play football*（正确应为 like playing 或 like to play）。
- 错点2：混淆 stop/remember/forget 后接 to do 和 doing 的含义（如 stop to do 是停下来去做另一件事，stop doing 是停止正在做的事）。
- 错点3：分词作状语时忽视逻辑主语的一致性（中学考纲高频压轴陷阱）。
4. 【经典例句】：
- She decided to study hard for the test. (她决定为考试努力学习。——表未来/目的)
- My brother enjoys playing basketball. (我弟弟喜欢打篮球。——表习惯/体验)
- Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful. (从山上俯瞰，城市看起来很美。——表被动完成)

questions.question: I want ______ a new bicycle for my ninth birthday.
questions.explanation: want 后接动词不定式做宾语，固定搭配为 want to do sth.（想要做某事）。

questions.question: Lucy enjoys ______ storybooks in the school library after class.
questions.explanation: enjoy 表示“喜爱”，后接动词必须用动名词形式，即 enjoy doing sth.。

questions.question: Would you like ______ some hot milk before going to bed?
questions.explanation: would like 表示“想要”，后面习惯接不定式，即 would like to do sth.。

questions.question: My little brother is very good at ______ football.
questions.explanation: at 是介词，介词后面遇到动词时，动词要变成动名词形式（-ing 形式）。

questions.question: The weather was sunny, so we decided ______ a walk in the park.
questions.explanation: decide 表示“决定”，后接动词不定式作宾语，固定结构为 decide to do sth.。

questions.question: Please wash your hands after you finish ______ your drawing.
questions.explanation: finish 表示“完成”，后面接动词的 -ing 形式，即 finish doing sth.。

questions.question: The teacher came into the classroom, so the students stopped ______.
questions.explanation: stop doing sth. 表示“停止正在做的事情”；stop to do sth. 表示“停下来去做另一件事”。根据语境，学生们是停止讲话，故选 C。

questions.question: Listening to cheerful music always makes me ______ happy.
questions.explanation: make 是使役动词，后接省略 to 的不定式作宾语补足语，即 make sb. do sth.。

questions.question: Tom practices ______ English every morning to improve his oral skills.
questions.explanation: practice 表示“练习”，后面只能接动名词做宾语，即 practice doing sth.。

questions.question: It is raining heavily outside. You need ______ an umbrella with you.
questions.explanation: need 作实义动词且主语为人时，后接不定式，表示“需要做某事”，即 need to do sth.。

questions.question: Keep ______, and you will surely succeed in the competition.
questions.explanation: keep doing sth. 是固定短语，意为“坚持做某事 / 不断做某事”。

questions.question: Our family plans ______ a movie together this coming Sunday.
questions.explanation: plan 表示“计划”，后接不定式作宾语，表示将要进行的动作，即 plan to do sth.。

questions.question: I am really looking forward to ______ my grandparents in Beijing.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词（非不定式符号），后面必须跟动名词，即 look forward to doing sth.。

questions.question: Don't forget ______ the door when you leave the house.
questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 表示“忘记去做某事（还没做）”；forget doing sth. 表示“忘记做过某事（已做）”。出门前提醒锁门是未做的事，选 B。

questions.question: My sister spent two hours ______ this cute Lego castle.
questions.explanation: spend time (in) doing sth. 是固定搭配，意为“花费时间做某事”。

questions.question: ______ along the quiet river bank, I suddenly heard someone calling my name.
questions.explanation: 现在分词短语作时间/伴随状语。逻辑主语是 I，与 walk 之间是主动关联且动作正在发生，故用 Walking。

questions.question: ______ by the sudden loud noise, the young child burst into tears immediately.
questions.explanation: 过去分词作原因状语。逻辑主语 the young child 与 frighten 之间是被动关系（被吓到），用过去分词 Frightened。

questions.question: ______ all his homework, Peter was allowed to go outside and play football with his friends.
questions.explanation: 现在分词的完成式（Having done）作状语，表示该动作发生在主句谓语动作（was allowed）之前。

questions.question: With all the lights ______, the dark room looked a bit spooky.
questions.explanation: With 复合结构（with + 宾语 + 宾补）。lights 与 turn off 之间是被动且已完成的关系，故宾补用过去分词 turned off。

questions.question: There are still several complex issues ______ before the agreement can be signed.
questions.explanation: 不定式的被动语态（to be done）作后置定语。issues 与 discuss 之间是被动关系，且表示将来发生的动作。

questions.question: I saw him ______ across the street just now, but he vanished into the crowd within seconds.
questions.explanation: see sb. doing sth. 表示看见某人“正在做某事”（强调过程或瞬间进行）；see sb. do sth. 强调全过程。此处表示看到他在跑着穿过街道，选 running。

questions.question: He rushed all the way to the railway station, only ______ that the train had already departed.
questions.explanation: only to do sth. 作结果状语，常表示令人出乎意料或遗憾的“不好的结果”。

questions.question: ______ the severe weather conditions, the organizers decided to postpone the outdoor sports event.
questions.explanation: Considering... 属于分词转化为介词/状语的固定用法，意为“考虑到……”、“鉴于……”。

questions.question: The suspect claimed ______ at home watching television when the crime took place.
questions.explanation: claim 后接不定式作宾语；由于“在家里看电视”发生在“声称（claimed）”之前，故需用不定式的完成式 to have been。

questions.question: Deeply ______ by the doctor's selfless dedication, all the patients expressed their sincere gratitude.
questions.explanation: 过去分词作状语。逻辑主语是 all the patients，表示“深受感动”（被动心理状态），故使用过去分词 moved。

questions.question: ______ independently in an unfamiliar environment requires courage, patience, and resilience.
questions.explanation: 动名词（Living）作句子的主语，表达抽象或一般性的行为，谓语动词 requires 动词单数形式。

questions.question: ______ for three consecutive weeks, the patient was finally allowed to leave the hospital.
questions.explanation: 现在分词的完成被动式（Having been done）作状语。逻辑主语 the patient 与 treat 之间是被动关系，且“治疗”发生在“出院（was allowed）”之前。

questions.question: Before going to the job interview, David went to the hair salon to have his hair ______.
questions.explanation: have sth. done 为固定致使结构，表示“让/请别人做某事”。hair 与 cut 是被动关系，故用过去分词 cut。

questions.question: The moment I entered the kitchen, I could smell something ______ in the oven.
questions.explanation: smell sth. doing 结构，表示“闻到某物正在（发出烧焦等）动作”，用现在分词表示动作正在进行。

questions.question: ______ the peak of the mountain after a tough six-hour hike, the climbers let out a cheer.
questions.explanation: 现在分词完成式（Having reached）作状语。逻辑主语是 the climbers，登顶动作发生在欢呼（let out a cheer）之前，强调先后顺序。
